latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of 港股资讯早报 (HK Stock Morning Brief) skill for OpenClaw.
- Generates professional Hong Kong stock market morning briefs based on 聚源数据 MCP via mcporter, covering indices, sectors, company announcements, research, southbound funds, industry panorama, and global markets.
- Requires environment setup: mcporter installation, MCP service configuration with valid JY_API_KEY, and OpenClaw integration.
- Outputs Markdown and PDF reports with echarts charts, data source annotation, and clear structure, saved under /home/liust/openclaw/workspace/reports/.
- Strict data sourcing from 聚源数据 MCP; each item must reference its originating API and trading date. No prediction or unsupported data.
- Includes detailed setup and troubleshooting instructions, data coverage standards, and fallback protocols for missing data.
